''See also: [[Witnesses (The Elder Empire: Shadow) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Witnesses are members of a [[Guild]] tasked with providing impartial and precise accounts of significant occurrences within [[Imperial]] history. Their reports carry immense political weight, as the information they record can influence the opinions of people throughout [[The Empire|the Empire]]. To maintain their function, Witnesses typically operate in pairs consisting of a [[Silent One]], who serves as a protector, and a Chronicler, who is responsible for the transcription and memorization of data. While the [[Guild]] generally advises against romantic involvement between members, it is known that some Witnesses engage in relationships. Members of this group are characterized by their specific attire, which includes cloths covering their mouths and candles attached to their belts, as well as loose clothing designed to allow for combat if required. [[The Guild]]'s leadership is notable for its ability to perform both the protective and recording roles interchangeably.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Witnesses serve as an organization for which [[Naberius Clayborn]] works. Within this group, members are discouraged from forming personal relationships by the [[Guild]]. During an interrogation, [[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]] instructed a prisoner to reserve his biography for the Witnesses. Although two of these individuals were present during certain events, [[Shera]] has a history of killing members of the group.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]] told the prisoner to save his biography for the Witnesses.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Witnesses are a guild dedicated to speaking the unvarnished truth and serving as neutral arbitrators. Operating in pairs composed of a Chronicler and a [[Silent One]], these individuals possess the ability to collaborate on constructing boxes used to seal [[Vessels]]. During the events in the tower, both sets of Witnesses remained alive while reporting on the deaths of various [[Guild Heads]]. As a source of hope following recent events, the twin Witnesses were specifically identified by [[Nathanael Bareius|Bareius]] as a pair that should not be assassinated.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Witnesses can collaborate on creating boxes to seal [[Vessels]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Witnesses work in pairs consisting of a Chronicler and a [[Silent One]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Both sets of Witnesses were still alive in the tower.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
